interview.name: Nell
interview.answer: It’s planned for Saturday around 10, but the location still hasn’t been specified.

reflections: Nell is checking in on a shared repair effort and wants timely updates from others.
Bo seems loosely informed rather than deeply involved, suggesting the group is still coordinating basics.
Opal is actively present at the repair drive and functioning as a local point of contact for Nell.
Nell is trying to coordinate incomplete information and is actively checking in with multiple people to learn the latest status.
Opal and Ira are responsive helpers who are willing to monitor changes and relay updates back to Nell.
The repair drive seems to be nearing completion, with the remaining work focused on final repairs, volunteers, and donations.
Nell is trying to coordinate the repair drive by gathering details and relaying updates, rather than assuming she has the full picture.
Ira is acting as a helpful intermediary who keeps an ear out and shares confirmed information as soon as he can.
Noah and Eli are responsive and cooperative, but both still need practical details like what to bring, where to go, and what is expected.
Nell is trying to stay informed but lacks the latest details, so she repeatedly asks for confirmation and is open to being redirected to the right source.
Eli is practical and action-oriented, asking about logistics and what to bring, then following the suggested sign-up/check-in process.
Oren appears to be the person with the needed concrete update, and the group is converging on a Saturday around 10 repair drive with coordination still in progress.
Nell is trying to get the repair drive details straight and repeatedly asks for the latest update.
The event has shifted from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center, and multiple people are helping spread the correction.
Oren, Jules, and Mara are each offering practical support, with Mara taking on the detailed follow-up by sending the repair list.
